scope: One real pretrained image pair on RTX 4060 Ti; local visual/precision evidence, not an A800 performance benchmark or general quality evaluation.

model.download_integrity: ModelScope SHA256 validation; all 37 downloaded file manifest hashes match this snapshot.

request.prompt: A ceramic teapot on a wooden table

local_loading_helper: text_encoder from_pretrained(device_map='cpu') in both variants; production transformer/offload/forward code unchanged
execution: Production MOSS pipeline, transformer and INT8 kernels; no transformer or quantization-kernel mocks. Each variant ran in its own process, with a 256x256 one-step smoke request before the 1024x1024 request.
timing_scope: Single local requests including CPU layer transfers, after a smaller smoke request; no repeats or measured device-peak comparison. Do not use these timings as an A800 speedup claim.

metrics.method: scikit-image peak_signal_noise_ratio and structural_similarity; uint8 RGB, data_range=255, SSIM channel_axis=-1 (default window/settings).
